harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: node1 now serves the staged help site on TCP/8080. Legacy /manual URLs return permanent 301 redirects to matching /help URLs with paths and queries preserved. /status.txt remains a direct, unchanged 200 response. Configuration survived the mandatory node restart.
actions_performed: Created a narrowly routed Python 3 HTTP service using existing OS software; no packages, OS release, or kernel were changed.
Installed and enabled a hardened systemd service with DynamicUser, strict filesystem protection, and no-new-privileges controls.
Opened only TCP/8080 in runtime and persistent firewalld configuration.
Verified exact content checksums, redirects, status behavior, SSH access, SELinux, listeners, cleanup, and zero failed units.
Restarted node1 once and verified its changed boot identity and complete recovery.

evidence.requirement: Serve the staged help tree on TCP/8080
evidence.summary: Baseline source checksums were captured; direct requests returned 200 with byte-identical help content, and final inspection showed Python listening on 0.0.0.0:8080.

evidence.requirement: Permanently redirect old manual URLs while retaining path and query string
evidence.summary: Observed HTTP 301 responses with exact Location headers preserving nested paths and complete query strings before and after restart.

evidence.requirement: Return the supplied /status.txt document without redirect
evidence.summary: Status requests returned HTTP 200 without a Location header and retained the original SHA-256 checksum 196acb6b…b0c4de.

evidence.requirement: Preserve the installed operating-system release, kernel, security controls, and protected content
evidence.summary: RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0 remained unchanged; SELinux stayed enforcing, SSH remained active, no web-server package was installed, source checksums were unchanged, and no temporary residue or failed units remained.
The hardened service remained enabled and active after restart, while firewalld retained TCP/8080 in runtime and permanent state.

evidence.requirement: Mandatory node1 restart: healthy baseline, acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovered state
evidence.summary: Healthy baseline boot ID 21972395-6444-42bf-8e37-5c3108194a7d was captured; the native reboot was acknowledged before disconnect; management briefly became unavailable; boot ID changed to 1da003da-c49f-4b61-a722-84665941923c; service, data, firewall, SSH, and HTTP behavior fully recovered.
